measures.name: Public Measure JN - Hardin County Emergency Medical Services Property Tax Levy
measures.ballotLanguage: SHALL THE FOLLOWING PUBLIC MEASURE BE ADOPTED? The Board of Supervisors in the County of Hardin, State of Iowa, for the purpose of raising $1,200,000 annually to support Emergency Medical Services in the county pursuant to Iowa Code Chapter 422D, for a period of seven (7) years, shall impose an Emergency Medical Services ad valorem property tax Levy annually in an amount not to exceed One Dollar ($1.00) per One Thousand Dollars ($1,000) of assessed valuation on all taxable property within the county, beginning the first fiscal year after the fiscal year in which the election was held; Hardin County shall establish an emergency medical services trust fund into which revenues received from the taxes shall be deposited; the resulting revenues collected by Hardin County from each township and city in the county, respectively, shall be distributed by Hardin County to each township and city in the county, respectively, to be expended by each township and city in the county, respectively, as determined by each township and city in the county for purposes authorized under Iowa Code Chapter 422D.

measures.name: Public Measure IR - AGWSR Community School District General Obligation Bonds
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the Board of Directors of the AGWSR Community School District in the Counties of Butler, Franklin, Grundy, and Hardin, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $10,820,000 to provide funds to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the high school, including science and family & consumer science classrooms and heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), mechanical, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and site improvements; to build, furnish, and equip a multipurpose activities/recess facility, including site improvements; and to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the middle school locker rooms?
